user.title: Choose your water purifier
user.description: These Intellon purifiers were found on your local network. No Atomberg login is needed.

manual.title: Connect to your water purifier
manual.description: Enter the purifier's IP address from your router's device list. It must already be connected to Wi-Fi. If your devices use separate VLANs, Home Assistant must be able to receive the purifier's broadcast replies.

finish.title: Your local connection works
finish.description:
Home Assistant read your purifier directly at {host}. No cloud connection or account was used.

After finishing, try Display sleep in Home Assistant. To keep the purifier fully offline, block its internet access in your router, then check that its readings and controls still work. Keep local access between Home Assistant and the purifier allowed.

error.cannot_connect: The purifier did not return valid local status. Check its IP address, power and network access. Across VLANs, ordinary routing alone cannot carry its broadcast replies.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That address belongs to a different purifier.
